# The `gh pr merge` and `--auto` spellings this repository still permits, one per line as
# <path>:<func>, each with the reason a reader can check.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-18: nothing reaches the dev merge queue but a batch. `gh pr merge --auto`
# is not an enqueue -- it is a standing instruction the forge executes later, with nobody in
# the room -- and four pull requests landed on dev that way that morning, from calls made
# while they were still red. Admission to a merge queue is internal/merge.Enqueuer.Enqueue
# and nothing else.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestNoGhPrMergeSpellingInTheToolsGo checks it in both directions:
# an unlisted call is red, and an entry whose call has left is red too.
